name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Avatar as AvatarPrimitive } from '@shardsui/svelte/avatar';
  import type { ComponentProps } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils.js';

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    ...restProps
  }: ComponentProps<typeof AvatarPrimitive.Fallback> = $props();
</script>

<AvatarPrimitive.Fallback
  bind:ref
  class={cn('flex size-full items-center justify-center rounded-[inherit] bg-border', className)}
  data-slot="avatar-fallback"
  {...restProps}
></AvatarPrimitive.Fallback>

<script lang="ts">
  import type { Avatar as AvatarPrimitive } from '@shardsui/svelte/avatar';
  import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils.js';
  import AvatarFallback from './avatar-fallback.svelte';
  import Avatar from './avatar.svelte';

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    children,
    ...restProps
  }: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof AvatarPrimitive.Root>, 'children'> & {
    children?: Snippet;
  } = $props();
</script>

<Avatar
  bind:ref
  class={cn('text-muted-foreground', className)}
  data-slot="avatar-group-count"
  {...restProps}
>
  <AvatarFallback>{@render children?.()}</AvatarFallback>
</Avatar>
{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
  import { Avatar as AvatarPrimitive } from '@shardsui/svelte/avatar';
  import type { ComponentProps } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils.js';

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    ...restProps
  }: ComponentProps<typeof AvatarPrimitive.Image> = $props();
</script>

<AvatarPrimitive.Image
  bind:ref
  class={cn('size-full rounded-[inherit] object-cover', className)}
  data-slot="avatar-image"
  {...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Avatar as AvatarPrimitive } from '@shardsui/svelte/avatar';
  import type { ComponentProps } from 'svelte';
  import type { HTMLAnchorAttributes, HTMLButtonAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils.js';

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    ...restProps
  }: ComponentProps<typeof AvatarPrimitive.Root> &
    // Attributes for `as="a"` / `as="button"` avatars, spread onto the rendered element.
    Pick<HTMLAnchorAttributes, 'href' | 'rel' | 'target'> &
    Pick<HTMLButtonAttributes, 'disabled' | 'type'> = $props();
</script>

<AvatarPrimitive.Root
  bind:ref
  data-slot="avatar"
  class={cn(
    'relative isolate inline-flex size-(--avatar-size,--spacing(8)) shrink-0 select-none items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full align-middle font-medium text-[calc(var(--avatar-size,--spacing(8))*0.375)]/none',
    className
  )}
  {...restProps}
/>
